inei_2022_2024.name: Perú: Muertes violentas asociadas a hechos delictivos dolosos, 2022-2024 — Anexos estadísticos (Cuadros 1-11, 14, 15)
inei_2022_2024.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística e Informática (INEI); data from Policía Nacional del Perú and Ministerio Público
inei_2022_2024.notes: Cuadro 1: deaths and homicide rate per 100,000 by department (Lima also split into Lima Metropolitana and Región Lima). Cuadros 2-11: percentage distributions by department (sex, age group, relationship to presumed perpetrator, homicide type incl. sicariato/feminicidio, place, means, instrument, month, weekday, hour) — unit 'percent of victims', the 'Total'=100 columns omitted. Cuadro 14: counts by district (only districts with at least one death in 2022-2024; zeros shown for the other years) plus province subtotal rows; district rows sum to the national totals 2,879 / 3,126 / 3,426. Cuadro 15: rate by province (provinces with 100,000+ inhabitants only). Rates kept at the full precision stored in the xlsx cells. Not kept: Cuadros 12-13 (top-30 provinces/districts by sex, percentages), sheet 'Hoja1' (working sheet).

inei_2019_2020.name: Homicidios en el Perú, contándolos uno a uno, 2019 y 2020 — Gráfico N° 2.2 (deaths by department)
inei_2019_2020.publisher: INEI (Comité Estadístico Interinstitucional de la Criminalidad, CEIC)
inei_2019_2020.notes: Extracted with pdftotext -layout from the labelled bar chart Gráfico 2.2; department values sum to the published totals (2,385 for 2019, 1,903 for 2020). Lima split into Lima Metropolitana and 'Departamento de Lima' (= Región Lima). Source notes 2019-2020 are not strictly comparable with earlier years. Provincial data in this edition are top-30 charts only; not extracted.
